name: paprika
description: Local design tool for AI agents with a built-in MCP server.

scripts.dev: pnpm go:build && server/bin/paprika import packages/e2e/fixtures/demo.paprika.json --db dev.db --replace && server/bin/paprika serve --db dev.db
scripts.test:render: cd crates/render && cargo test && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
scripts.go:build: cd server && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags nodynamic -buildvcs=false -o bin/paprika ./cmd/paprika
scripts.go:vet: cd server && CGO_ENABLED=0 go vet -tags nodynamic ./...
scripts.go:test: pnpm go:vet && cd server && CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -tags nodynamic ./...
scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm go:golden && git diff --exit-code -- server/internal/core/testdata server/contract && pnpm test && pnpm go:test && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:e2e
